title: Take away their most efficient high-volume actions
supporting_stats: Offensive Rebound: 75.7% on 37 attempts; Cut: 63.2% on 136 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points above their 50.2% overall clip on 15+ attempts. Offensive Rebound: hit a body on every shot before going to the ball. Cut: jump to the ball on every pass and see man and ball -- no back-cuts behind ball-watchers.

title: Funnel them into their worst high-volume looks
supporting_stats: Spot-Up: 42.0% on 471 attempts; Hand Off: 44.6% on 56 attempts
recommendation: Each is 5+ points below their 50.2% overall clip -- don't help off these actions; make them keep taking them.

title: Pressure the actions they turn it over on
supporting_stats: Post-Up: 21 TO in 92 uses (22.8% vs 11.6% across all actions); Transition: 49 TO in 266 uses (18.4% vs 11.6% across all actions)
recommendation: Loosest actions per use, not the most common ones -- load ball pressure and gap help onto these specifically rather than pressing everything.
